reporting_boundaries.adapter_status: The AISKG external transfer systems are new prespecified adapters that inherit AISKG-style type constraints and evidence-context logic; they are not the unchanged mushroom-domain v3.1.2 extractor.
reporting_boundaries.document_scope: Sentence-local results are the closest architectural match to AISKG v3.1.2. Full-document results are a cross-sentence stress test.
reporting_boundaries.gold_entities: All BioRED/BioREDirect evaluations in this package use gold entity mentions and normalized concept identifiers to isolate relation extraction.
reporting_boundaries.test_lock: Model features and thresholds are fitted on train and tuned on development only. The test split is evaluated once after locking.
reporting_boundaries.third_party: BioRED/BioREDirect data, code, and model weights are downloaded from official NCBI locations at runtime and are not redistributed in this ZIP.
